identityDecision: Use the named three-lock Ørje complex as the primary anchor and the adjacent canal museum as a secondary interpretation anchor.

historicalScope.finding: Three hand-operated locks opened in 1860 lift vessels approximately ten metres. The locks are one component of the approximately 80-kilometre Halden Canal and sit beside lock residences, the Engebret Soot memorial, Ørje Brug and the canal museum.
